export default "# Markdown Decoration Demo\n\nUse this example to test inline markdown decoration such as bold, italic, and font color inside Open Lyric fences.\n\n```ol:Config\n- Title: Markdown Decoration Demo\n- Subtitle: Styling text inside Open Lyric fences\n- Description:\n\tThis draft shows **bold**, *italic*, and <font color=\"#0f766e\">color</font> text\n\tinside fenced Open Lyric sections while chords still align with lyrics.\n- Artist: Open Lyric Team\n- Copyright: 2026 Open Lyric\n- Key: D\n- Tempo: 74bpm\n- Time: 4/4\n- Theme: Hope-filled worship\n- Structure: IV1CDO\n- Genre: Worship\n- Style: Contemporary\n```\n\n```ol:Intro\n| D | A/C# | Bm7 | G |\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 1\n[D]You turn the **darkest** night to [A/C#]*morning*\n[Bm7]You speak in <font color=\"#0f766e\">mercy</font> over [G]me\n```\n\n```ol:Chorus\n|[D]Sing a **new** song, let the *whole* heart rise\n|[A/C#]Hold to the <font color=\"#2563eb\">promise</font> lighting up the skies\n|[Bm7]Grace is still unfolding, [G]grace is still alive\n```\n\n```ol:Breakdown\nSpeak this softly:\n**You are near**\n*You are faithful*\n<font color=\"#dc2626\">You never let us go</font>\n```\n\n```ol:Outro\n|[D]Stay with me in the *quiet* [G]light\n```\n"
