export default "# Twelve-Eight Lanterns\n\nUse this example to test 12/8 time, the singular `Strumming Pattern` alias, and extended chord spellings.\n\n```ol:Config\n- Title: Twelve-Eight Lanterns\n- Artist: Open Lyric Team\n- Copyright: 2026 Open Lyric\n- Key: F#m\n- Tempo: 54bpm\n- Time: 12/8\n- Theme: Night prayer\n- Structure: IV1PCV2CB1FO\n- Genre: Worship\n- Style: 12/8 Ballad\n- Strumming Pattern: d--u--d--u- | d-u-u-d-u-u\n```\n\n```ol:Intro\n| F#m | Emaj7 | Dadd9 | C#sus4 |\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 1\nLantern light is trembling, but Your promise stays\nMidnight keeps on breathing, but Your mercy stays\n```\n\n```ol:Pre-Chorus\n[Dadd9]Even in the shadow, [Emaj7]You are leading me\n[F#m]Even in the silence, [C#sus4]You are speaking peace\n```\n\n```ol:Chorus\n|[F#m]Hold me through the midnight |[Emaj7]keep my heart awake\n|[Dadd9]Hold me through the midnight |[C#sus4]for Your mercy's sake\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 2\nEvery distant answer glows within Your word\nEvery hidden ember wakes when You are heard\n```\n\n```ol:Bridge 1\n|[Dadd9]Light upon light |[Emaj7]grace upon grace\n|[F#m]Song upon song |[C#sus4]face upon face\n```\n\n```ol:Final-Chorus\n|[G#m]Hold me through the midnight |[F#maj7]keep my heart awake\n|[Eadd9]Hold me through the midnight |[D#sus4]for Your mercy's sake\n```\n\n```ol:Outro\nLantern light keeps burning while Your presence stays\n```\n"
