export default "# Commented Draft Template\n\nUse this example to test draft comments with ignored `//` lines across config, intro, instrumental, lyric, bridge, and outro fences.\n\n```ol:Config\n// Draft template with comments in every fence type.\n- Title: Commented Draft Template\n- Artist: Open Lyric Team\n- Copyright: 2026 Open Lyric\n- Key: A\n- Tempo: 82bpm\n- Time: 4/4\n- Structure: IV1N1CB1O\n```\n\n```ol:Intro\n// Pad only for the first pass.\n{p: #1 } | A | E/G# | F#m | D |\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 1\n// Draft this lyric later.\n[A]You are near when daylight fades\n[E/G#]You are near when courage shakes\n```\n\n```ol:Instrumental 1\n// Guitar echoes the chorus motif.\n{c: Gtr Solo } | A | E/G# | F#m | D | (2x)\n```\n\n```ol:Chorus\n// Keep the chorus short on purpose.\n|[A]You are here |[E/G#]You are faithful\n|[F#m]You are near |[D]You are kind\n```\n\n```ol:Bridge 1\n// Add a second line later if needed.\n|[D]All my questions |[E]find their rest in You\n```\n\n```ol:Outro\n// Leave this instrumental while arranging.\n{c: Piano + pads } | A | E/G# | F#m | D |\n```\n"
