export default "# Bilingual Mercy Response\n\nUse this example to test Unicode lyrics, bilingual translation pairs, bar-aligned lyric lines, and chord annotations in the same file.\n\n```ol:Config\n- Title: Bilingual Mercy Response\n- Artist: Open Lyric Team\n- Copyright: 2026 Open Lyric\n- Key: D\n- Tempo: 72bpm\n- Time: 4/4\n- Structure: IV1CV2B1CO\n```\n\n```ol:Intro\n| D | A/C# | Bm7 | G |\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 1\nYour mercy meets us in the morning light\nYour kindness stays with us through every night\n```\n\n```ol:Chorus\n|[D]ព្រះអង្គស្រឡាញ់ខ្ញុំ |[A/C#]ទ្រង់មិនចាកចេញ\n\tYou have held me close  You never walk away\n|[Bm7]ពេលយប់ងងឹតមក |[G]ពន្លឺទ្រង់នៅតែភ្លឺ\n\tWhen the night is deep  Your light is still with me\n```\n\n```ol:Verse 2\n[D]When my strength is small, [A/C#]Your grace is strong\n[Bm7]When my song is lost, [G]You sing me home\n```\n\n```ol:Bridge 1\n// The translation line can omit chord annotations.\n|[Bm7]Holy are You Lord |[G]Faithful are You Lord\n\tHoly are You Lord  Faithful are You Lord\n|[D]Mercy without end |[A/C#]Peace that makes us whole\n\tMercy without end  Peace that makes us whole\n```\n\n```ol:Outro\n|[D]Jesus, keep us near |[A/C#]Jesus, keep us near\n```\n"
